scope: Read-only mathematical/code review; synthetic receipts inspected; no actual campaign fits

GP.negative_hessian: hazard(z)*(hazard(z)-z)/sigma^2; nonnegative; continued-fraction tail difference avoids catastrophic cancellation
GP.whitened_negative_logposterior: 0.5*vTv - sum(logLikelihood(mean+L*v)); Hessian I+L^T W L positive definite
GP.Laplace_predictive_variance: diag(Kqq)-diag(Kqo sqrtW (I+sqrtW Koo sqrtW)^-1 sqrtW Koq)+sigma^2
GP.joint_support_update: Original population and selected support factors recomputed jointly with fixed mean/kernel/noise; old mode is warm start only
GP.query_outcomes: Stripped from prediction input; likelihood scoring evaluates observed endpoint as expected
GP.shape_zero_label: Condition-shape-kernel ablation, not intercept-only when global GP remains uncertain
GP.mean_estimation_note: Standalone default uses source-balanced CensoredBasquin; current v6 runner supplies source-balanced training-only HIERARCHICAL Basquin location, sigma and tau references. Residual GP likelihood is unit-weight. The fixed mean is not re-estimated after selected support.
GP.numerical_jitter: Training latent covariance jitter only, exposed; exact Gaussian synthetic algebra receipt agrees
GP.zero_covariance_anchor: Allowed explicitly; jitter keeps factorization defined while zero query cross-covariance gives a fixed-mean Gaussian predictive anchor.
